paper.title: Revisiting partition priming in judgement under uncertainty: replication and extension Registered Report of Fox and Rottenstreich (2003)

review.reason: Accepted as a reading-only scholarly reconstruction with stated source gaps and no runtime or reanalysis claim.
checks: Four named tasks share N=603; original Study 2 is excluded; six scenario pages and hypothetical financial-choice scope preserved.
81 PDF quotations verified at cited physical pages. Weaker weather/sport/job effects, unsupported financial results and post-analysis Mann–Whitney/two-of-three decisions retained.
Archived supplement page 36 checked for compensation and conflicting recruitment thresholds. QSF inspected for choice randomization and happen-before-not-happen order.
